dialogue.intro_maelle.verso_1: This square should be louder. I only hear ash falling.
dialogue.intro_maelle.maelle_1: Then listen harder. Paris still remembers every step we take.
dialogue.intro_maelle.verso_2: The road east is open. We move before the patrol finds us.
dialogue.intro_maelle.maelle_2: Not blindly. Check the campfire, keep your blade close, and follow the boulevard.
dialogue.intro_maelle.maelle_3: If the mirrors start singing, do not answer them.
dialogue.maelle_repeat.maelle_1: The eastern boulevard is our best route. Stay near the campfires when you need to change gear.
dialogue.maelle_confrontation.verso_1: Maelle? I thought the boulevard swallowed everyone.
dialogue.maelle_confrontation.maelle_1: Do not use my name like a memory. The mirrors learned his voice too.
dialogue.maelle_confrontation.verso_2: I am not a clone. I am your brother.
dialogue.maelle_confrontation.maelle_2: Then survive like him. Draw your blade.
dialogue.maelle_reconcile.maelle_1: Only Verso hesitates before the final cut.
dialogue.maelle_reconcile.verso_1: I was afraid you would make me prove it again.
dialogue.maelle_reconcile.maelle_2: No. From here, we test the world together.
dialogue.silent_market_after.maelle_1: They were not guarding goods. They were guarding the road itself.
dialogue.silent_market_after.verso_1: Then the road remembers where the next lock is.
dialogue.silent_market_after.maelle_2: North-east. A crossing, then glass. Keep your MP ready.
dialogue.glass_shrine_memory.verso_1: The glass is warm. Someone camped here before us.
dialogue.glass_shrine_memory.maelle_1: Previous expeditions, maybe. Or copies that learned to pray.
dialogue.glass_shrine_memory.verso_2: Either way, the mirror gate is close.
dialogue.glass_shrine_memory.maelle_2: Then we stop walking like survivors and start walking like an expedition.
dialogue.memory_paris_first_echo.line_1: Expedition 32 reached this road with four blades and no map.
dialogue.memory_paris_first_echo.line_2: Their last note says the first scout only attacks what still remembers its name.
dialogue.memory_western_watch_echo.line_: A watchman wrote that the west fire burned blue whenever clones crossed the market.
So the fire was warning them. They just stopped listening.
dialogue.memory_glass_shrine_echo.line_1: The shrine glass records pain before it records faces.
dialogue.memory_glass_shrine_echo.line_2: Then every reflection here knows exactly why we keep moving.

objective.defeat_meadow_scout.title: First Contact
objective.defeat_meadow_scout.body: Verso is alone. Defeat the road scout before pushing deeper into Paris.
objective.meet_maelle.title: A Familiar Voice
objective.meet_maelle.body: Follow the boulevard east and find Maelle before the mirrors close in.
objective.win_maelle_duel.title: Prove the Memory
objective.win_maelle_duel.body: Maelle thinks Verso is a clone. Win the duel and prove the memory is real.
objective.reconcile_maelle.title: Together Again
objective.reconcile_maelle.body: Speak with Maelle after the duel so she can rejoin the expedition.
objective.secure_western_watch.title: Western Watch
objective.secure_western_watch.body: Maelle is back. Take the western side path and secure the old watch fire before pushing east.
objective.clear_silent_market.title: Silent Market
objective.clear_silent_market.body: The western watch is clear. Return through the silent market and break the first road ambush.
objective.win_pilgrim_crossing.title: Pilgrim Crossing
objective.win_pilgrim_crossing.body: The eastern road is opening. Win the crossing patrol before seeking the shrine.
objective.recover_glass_shrine.title: Glass Shrine
objective.recover_glass_shrine.body: Reach the glass shrine, claim the campfire, and defeat the sentinel guarding the route.
objective.reach_mirror_gate.title: Mirror Gate
objective.reach_mirror_gate.body: The final road is clear. Reach the mirror gate and defeat the clone.
objective.chapter_clear.title: Ashen Route Clear
objective.chapter_clear.body: The gate is quiet for now. Use campfires to prepare for the next route.
story.default_objective: Start alone on the Paris road. Defeat the scout, then find the voice waiting beyond the boulevard.
story.region.paris_square.name: Rue Cendre
story.region.paris_square.objective: Paris is quiet. Verso starts alone; follow the road east and survive the first scout.
story.region.meadow_wake.name: Meadow Wake
story.region.meadow_wake.objective: The first campfire is alive. Defeat the road scout, then follow the boulevard toward Maelle's signal.
story.region.silent_market.name: Silent Market
story.region.silent_market.objective: The market is empty, but the road still points east. Push through the ruins.
story.region.western_watch.name: Western Watch
story.region.western_watch.objective: A side path leads to an old watch post. Claim the campfire before returning to the main road.
story.region.pilgrim_crossing.name: Pilgrim Crossing
story.region.pilgrim_crossing.objective: The road splits around an enemy patrol. Win the crossing and the mirror gate will come into view.
story.region.glass_shrine.name: Glass Shrine
story.region.glass_shrine.objective: The shrine campfire offers one last recovery. Gather strength before the eastern road.
story.region.mirror_gate.name: Mirror Gate
story.region.mirror_gate.objective: The clone waits beyond the gate. Defeat it to prove Verso is more than an echo.
